subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit trusted skill-loader capability, and which runtime or plugin contract is allowed to claim it for the current skill snapshot?
rationale: Tool names are generic plugin-controlled identifiers, while selecting a loader changes the authority and provenance of instructions delivered to the model; source inspection cannot safely choose that security and cross-harness product contract.

options.title: Add trusted loader capability
options.body: Define a typed capability with verified skill identity, snapshot provenance, and fallback behavior, then make prompt construction prefer the resolved loader.

options.title: Keep direct-read loading
options.body: Retain `read` as the only native implicit-loading mechanism and document that plugins must supply their own non-conflicting prompt guidance.

options.title: Recognize the tool name
options.body: Prefer a case-insensitive `Skill` tool by convention, accepting collision and compatibility risks for simpler plugin integration.

recommendation.title: Add trusted loader capability
recommendation.body: Define a typed capability with verified skill identity, snapshot provenance, and fallback behavior, then make prompt construction prefer the resolved loader.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person across the central prompt and runtime integration surface where the product and security boundary must be selected.
